$comment: Default RPI workflow stages. Copy, edit and pass to /rpi:stages apply to customise. 'type' is immutable once a state exists in Linear: changing it requires archive-and-recreate.

stages.name: ready-for-questions
stages.description: Scoped and waiting for research questions to be written.

stages.name: questions-in-progress
stages.description: An agent is drafting the research questions.

stages.name: questions-in-review
stages.description: Research questions written, waiting for human review.

stages.name: ready-for-research
stages.description: Questions approved, waiting for research to start.

stages.name: research-in-progress
stages.description: An agent is researching the current state of the codebase.

stages.name: research-in-review
stages.description: Research written, waiting for human review of the facts.

stages.name: ready-for-design
stages.description: Research approved, waiting for design to start.

stages.name: design-in-progress
stages.description: Design discussion, PRD or TDD in progress. Decisions belong to the human.

stages.name: design-in-review
stages.description: Design written, waiting for human sign-off.

stages.name: ready-for-structure
stages.description: Design approved, waiting for the structure outline.

stages.name: structure-in-progress
stages.description: Slicing the design into vertical, independently testable phases.

stages.name: structure-in-review
stages.description: Outline written, waiting for human review of the phase boundaries.

stages.name: ready-for-plan
stages.description: Outline approved. Optional detailed-plan path only.

stages.name: plan-in-progress
stages.description: Expanding outline phases into code-level steps.

stages.name: plan-in-review
stages.description: Detailed plan written, waiting for human review.

stages.name: ready-for-dev
stages.description: Approved and ready for implementation to start.

stages.name: in-dev
stages.description: Implementing one phase at a time, with checks between phases.

stages.name: code-review
stages.description: Pull request open, waiting for review.
